UPDATE virtual_teachers SET avatar_url = CASE 
WHEN name = 'Ingrid' THEN 'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663082627627/ZaQZRZRxOcmtNnmc.jpg'
WHEN name = 'Carlos' THEN 'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663082627627/qGafKvMoaryOnZBl.jpg'
WHEN name = 'Jean' THEN 'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663082627627/ybTpGuXhyvsfgcAd.jpg'
ELSE avatar_url END
WHERE name IN ('Ingrid', 'Carlos', 'Jean');
